messages:
alice-newhire: Hi team! Quick onboarding benefits questions: 1) I put my domestic partner on medical during the 30-day life event window but HR portal says "pending verification"  what proof do you need and will coverage be effective back to my start date (2024-10-02)? 2) I elected dependent care FSA but I had daycare expenses on 2024-10-05 (before payroll deducted). If coverage is retro, can I claim those? 3) My commuter card activation still shows "not delivered". Who do I ping?

jamie-peopleops: Welcome @alice-newhire 44b Short answers: (1) For domestic partners we need a signed Domestic Partnership Affidavit + one proof of shared residence (lease/util). Upload both to Workday docs under "Benefits". Carrier rules vary: some carriers retro enrolees to the qualifying event date, others to the first of the next month. We'll escalate to BEN-4112 once you upload docs. If carrier approves retro we can get written confirmation.

jamie-peopleops: (2) For Dependent Care FSA: payroll deductions are per-pay-period; if coverage is retro and the expense is eligible you can submit a claim to the FSA admin. If the admin accepts the retro eligibility they will reimburse the expense. If not, we can consider a one-time payroll reimbursement with documentation, but that may be taxable. Use expense code "benefits-dcfsa" and attach the daycare receipt + carrier/administrator note.

payroll-bot: Automated: FSA/DCA elections follow IRS rules. Pretax contributions begin once the election is active in payroll. Retroactive corrections to pretax pretreatment require coordination with benefits admin and payroll. See /payroll/fsa-guide for claim steps and timelines.

commuter-bot: Vendor note: Commuter vendor (TransitPay) activation often fails if the signup email lands in Promotions or is blocked. Ticket COM-8247 opened for your email. Please whitelist notifications@transitpay.vendor and DM us the last 4 of your emp ID so we can resend.

sara-hr: If you want I can open BEN-4112 and include a request for retro effective date confirmation. @alice-newhire please upload the affidavit + lease and I'll assign to benefits. Also if you want us to pursue a one-time payroll fix vs. FSA admin route, tell us which you prefer and we'll advise on tax implications.

alice-newhire: Thanks everyone! Uploaded affidavit + lease to Workday and preferring carrier claim first. DMing my emp ID now. Appreciate the help :smile:
